{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First 10 values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the six QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for distribution of channels and segments
print(f"\nChannel distribution:\n{sales['channel'].value_counts()}")
print(f"\nCustomer segment distribution:\n{sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check for any other anomalies
print(f"\nAny duplicate order_id? {sales['order_id'].duplicated().any()}")"}
